## Distribution

- Package: `@carapace/vydra-provider`
- Install route: npm or ClawHub: `clawhub:@carapace/vydra-provider`

## Surface

- Providers: `vydra`
- Contracts: `imageGenerationProviders`, `speechProviders`, `videoGenerationProviders`
